findings.evidence: Mathlib `RingTheory/Valuation/Basic.lean:732,749` — `IsEquiv.eq_zero`, `IsEquiv.le_one_iff_le_one` (also `one_le_iff_one_le`, `eq_one_iff_eq_one`, `pos_iff`), all in the `IsEquiv` namespace; contrast `Basic.lean:1339`-area `isNontrivial_of_isEquiv` (one-directional) vs `IsEquiv.isNontrivial_iff` (iff). In-repo: `Continuous/Basic.lean:148 IsEquiv.isContinuous_iff`, `CharacteristicGroup.lean:124 IsEquiv.cofinalValue_iff`, `CharacteristicGroup.lean:184 IsEquiv.hasFullCharacteristicGroup_iff`, `ValueGroupTransport.lean:52 IsEquiv.valueGroupOrderIso`. The docstring at line 228 states the second is 'named to mirror `IsEquiv.eq_zero`', which the name does not do.
findings.fix: Rename to `Valuation.IsEquiv.ord_nonneg_iff` and `Valuation.IsEquiv.ord_eq_zero_iff` (Mathlib would also accept the repeated-side form `ord_nonneg_iff_ord_nonneg`), keeping `(h : v.IsEquiv w)` first, and call them as `h.ord_nonneg_iff` / `h.ord_eq_zero_iff` in `eq_of_isEquiv_of_surjective` (lines 243–244).
findings.issue: `ord_nonneg_iff_of_isEquiv` (line 222) and `ord_eq_zero_iff_of_isEquiv` (line 231) are iff-transfers along `v.IsEquiv w` but sit in the `Valuation` namespace with an `_of_isEquiv` suffix. `_of_isEquiv` is the repo/Mathlib pattern for one-directional transfer (`CharacteristicGroup.lean:113 CofinalValue.of_isEquiv`, Mathlib `Valuation.isNontrivial_of_isEquiv`); two-sided iffs go in the `IsEquiv` namespace so `h.foo_iff` works. Also, `ord_nonneg_iff_…` reads as an iff with something named by the rest of the name, but the rest names a hypothesis, not the right-hand side.

summary: Both extracted lemmas are two-sided transfers along `Valuation.IsEquiv`, but they are named `X_iff_of_isEquiv` in the bare `Valuation` namespace, contradicting the established convention in both Mathlib and this repo (`IsEquiv.X_iff`, taking `h` for dot notation). The docstring's claimed mirroring of `IsEquiv.eq_zero` is not achieved by the chosen names.
